newsitem.title: USA: Kansas City, Mo., adopts $748.4 mln annual budget.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City, Mo., adopts $748.4 mln annual budget.

text.p: The Kansas City, Mo., City Council adopted a $748.4 million budget for fiscal year 1998 beginning on May 1, the city budget director said Friday.
The budget adopted Thursday by the council includes $97.78 million for capital improvements, according to summaries provided by budget director Larry Plaisted.
The council added more than $9.5 million for neighborhood improvements to city manager Larry Brown's budget recommendations.

The council also cut the proposed budget by an equal amount to fund the additions in part through a one-time $1.2 million reduction to the reserve for economic incentives, $2 million reduction in technology development and $1.1 million cut from the public works equipment replacement fund.
